title: HookFamily
description: The editorial axis a proposed opening tests (PRD REQ-030/REQ-031). Members are the six variant axes named in the research memo's Hook Lab section — outcome-first vs problem-first, proof-first vs personality-first, utility-first vs curiosity-first. REQ-031 requires variants to differ by *hypothesis*, not by clip order; this enum is what makes 'distinct' checkable rather than asserted. Consumed from Phase 3 (`creative-brief-v1`); registered here so the enum registry has one home.
